name: Twilight Falls
summary: At Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight's Hammer cultists join with naga beneath the Ashenvale coast. Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus calls on Alliance champions to gather pendants from the fallen cultists and hinder their plans to awaken ancient evils.

sections.title: A Sanctum Defiled
sections.body: Beneath Ashenvale's Zoram Strand, Blackfathom Deeps lies in ruins. The night elf temple was once sacred to Elune and held a powerful moonwell, until the Sundering shattered it and plunged it beneath the sea. Now naga and cultists fill its halls. The waters have turned foul, and the cultists revere powers darker than the sea.

sections.title: Whispers of the Old Gods
sections.body: Twilight's Hammer worships the chaotic Old Gods and seeks their return, hoping to spread madness and ruin across the world. Reports in Darnassus say the cultists have joined with the naga in Blackfathom Deeps. In the submerged halls, they perform rituals and use the temple's tainted waters to feed their dark masters' resurgence.

sections.title: The Vigil of the Argent Dawn
sections.body: Argent Guard Manados watches over threats to Azeroth from Darnassus on behalf of the Argent Dawn. He sees the danger in Blackfathom Deeps: its horrors could reach every civilized race. The order offers aid and recognition to heroes who enter the flooded labyrinth, cull the cultists, and bring back the Twilight Pendants from their necks as proof of their defeat.

faq.answer: Argent Guard Manados is an Argent Dawn emissary stationed in Darnassus. He watches for cults and dark forces threatening Kalimdor and enlists adventurers to destroy them.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn concerned about Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn fights the Scourge in Lordaeron, but its charter also covers unnatural evils that threaten the world. Old God worship and the alliance between cultists and naga in Kalimdor could bring catastrophe if left unchecked.

Twilight's Hammer is a doomsday cult devoted to the chaotic Old Gods, primordial beings imprisoned beneath the earth long ago. Its followers seek an apocalyptic end that would let their masters rise and remake the world in terror and madness.

faq.q: What were the Twilight Pendants used for?
faq.answer: Twilight Pendants are dark talismans worn by Twilight's Hammer members to show their allegiance to the entities they worship. The Argent Dawn gathers them as proof that a cultist has been slain and neutralized.
Blackfathom Deeps was a night elf temple dedicated to Elune, famed for its powerful moonwell. The Great Sundering broke the earth and submerged its halls beneath the sea.

faq.q: Why are the Twilight's Hammer working with the naga?
faq.answer: The reasons for the union are not fully known. Both groups are drawn to the dark power stirring in the sunken temple. The cultists gain safe access to ancient submerged chambers, while the naga benefit from their sorceries and sacrificial rites.

angles.text: For a night elf, the desecration of a sacred temple and moonwell by Old God cultists and naga affronts Elune and Ashenvale's ancestral lands.
For the Alliance, Twilight's Hammer threatens from just south of Darkshore, and clearing Blackfathom Deeps helps secure northern Kalimdor.
As a paladin aligned with orders like the Argent Dawn, you see Twilight's Hammer's Old God worship as an abomination that demands righteous cleansing.
As a priest, you sense the corruption of the temple's once-sacred moonwell and the maddening, shadowy whispers driving the cultists deeper into madness.
